resourceContract.physicalModuleReference: Exactly one OnceLock initialization can request PIN of the full OS-selected already-loaded Ole32; intentional process-lifetime hold, not an unload/rollback or per-call leak. A post-PIN failure stays cached and does not attempt replacement.
resourceContract.retainedState: Only OnceLock<Result<one function pointer,HRESULT>>; no HMODULE owner unsafe Send/Sync, no threads, no pool, no per-call load/refcount or external path.
resourceContract.paths: 1024 UTF16 units maximum per temporary path buffer; native Intel/AMD64 selected actual system directory; WOW64 selects GetSystemWow64DirectoryW; full loaded identity uses CompareStringOrdinal(ignoreCase).
resourceContract.failure: All lookup/path failures return before any task-returning operation. Errors and cancellation after allocation preserve original exactly-once free path, conversion Result is evaluated after free.
resourceContract.unchanged: Original dialog options, validation, teacher file trust, audio endpoint bound and registration ownership, NativeProbe API, permission/session/cancellation logic unchanged.
